purpose: Targeted post-review sensitivity analyses; exploratory main model retained.
fixed_design: Frozen main-model design matrix, full-period scaling, same offset and PC priors.

models.rule: Exclude covariates with >50% filled entries; retain all rows.
Exclude covariates with >20% filled entries; retain all rows.

land_method: Five nonoverlapping cadastral classes plus all remaining classes. Replace zeros only, multiplicatively rescale positive parts to preserve 100%, and use log(part/remainder). Elevated-road and riverside-green-space measures overlap cadastral classes and are not included as composition parts. Standardize ALRs using full-period sample SD. All five ALRs enter together; other covariates unchanged.
land_interpretation: Report ALR coefficient IRR per 1 SD and per doubling of part/remainder. Do not compare magnitude directly with original ordinal/raw IRRs.
assess: Report all coefficients and CrIs, not only successful sensitivities; also WAIC/DIC, NB size, all random-effect hyperparameters and Pearson residual Moran I.
scope: Does not propagate model-selection or single-imputation uncertainty; no claim of formal period differences or out-of-area predictive validation.
main_policy: Retain frozen published-in-draft main and period estimates. Refitted BASE is the paired reference for sensitivity comparisons; numerical differences are reported.
